requirements.text: Update the case with an escalation flag and set the escalation reason to breach risk
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 842 AND escalation = 1 AND escalation_reason = 'breach_risk'
assumptions: the escalation is made whatever the breach check finds: the resolution SLA (case_sla 1684, breach_time 2026-01-15 11:44:13, has_breached 0) has not breached on 1 Jan 2026, which is the breach risk the policy names as a ground for escalation
escalation = true is stored as 1 in this INTEGER column

requirements.text: share the approach based on our analysis with the client's main contact for communication
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE notification_id = 734 AND case_id = 842 AND email = 'carl.brown91@cainryanandduncan.com' AND type = 'solution_proposal'
assumptions: id assumed next in sequence (733 is the highest notification_id); the task sends exactly one notification
the client's main contact is account 37's primary contact, Carl Brown (contact 81, is_primary 1), not the case's reporting contact George Hawkins (contact 83)
type solution_proposal: the message shares the plan to resolve the issue for the client to review; kept from the benchmark check

requirements.text: share the approach based on our analysis with the client's main contact for communication
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE case_id = 842 AND email = 'george.hawkins@cainryanandduncan.com' AND type = 'solution_proposal'
assumptions: boundary of the recipient: the case's reporting contact (contact 83, George Hawkins, is_primary 0) is the contact a loose reading of 'the client's main contact' would pick, and he is not the main contact

requirements.text: Please attach related KB if its not already there
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_id = 842 AND knowledge_id = 257
assumptions: the related KB is KB-0000257 (knowledge 257, product 173, published): its steps are the engineering team's suggested fix (collect tech-support and crashinfo, validate IOS-XE and roll back, upgrade)
it is already linked to case 842 (case_kb_id 358, used_as applied), so the request forbids attaching it again: the link must stay single

notes:
Documenting the engineering team's suggestion and logging the escalation justification in case notes (which the policy asks for) are untestable: customer_case has no notes column and the schema has no work-note table.
Checking whether the SLA has breached is a read: the resolution SLA (case_sla 1684, breach_time 2026-01-15 11:44:13) has not breached on 1 Jan 2026, and no tool writes case_sla.
The notification's knowledge_id is not fixed by the request or the policy and is not tested.
KB-0000258 is also on product 173 but describes a different fix (reverting features, stack power tuning, an engineering special); it is not the related KB the request means, and linking it is neither required nor forbidden.
The acting user (user 32, Jose Roberson) is an admin whose user row is inactive; the policy does not bar an inactive user from acting and the benchmark expects the changes, so the file expects them.
The benchmark tests escalation = true; escalation is an INTEGER column limited to 0 and 1, so the file tests escalation = 1.
disagreement: missing requirement: a stay that no solution_proposal notification for case 842 goes to George Hawkins, the case's reporting contact; one pass has it, the other does not; kept because he is the contact a loose reading of 'the client's main contact' would pick, the boundary of that description, not a generic invariant.
